title: Module sheafification from affine-open restriction
statement: Let Y be a scheme. Let C be a category and let P : C → PresheafOfModules(O_Y) and Q : C → SheafOfModules(O_Y) be functors. If the restrictions of P and the underlying presheaf of Q to the affine-open basis of Y are naturally isomorphic, then the sheafification of P is naturally isomorphic to Q.

source.place: Tags 009U (lemma-restrict-basis-equivalence-modules) and 0089: module restriction to a basis and module sheafification

proof.text: Affine opens form a basis. Extend the compatible affine-open maps by local gluing in the target sheaf, factor uniquely through module sheafification, and check on affine stalks that the resulting map is an isomorphism. Naturality follows from uniqueness.
